description: Ask the same question about many rows and collect the answers as a table (the app's Tables page) - e.g. 'which obligations does this paragraph impose?' for every chunk of a regulation. Rows are the passages of a collection (source_context_id: all its documents, or only document_ids; max_rows caps them) or texts you give (row_texts: one row per text, e.g. search hits you picked). A row sees its own text, and further evidence only from retrieval_context_ids (matching passages of those contexts, retrieved per row). Each row is answered by the LLM (by you, the calling agent: llm_tasks / llm_answer). The template (grid_profile_id) gives the prompt and the answer columns; your prompt, if given, replaces the template's prompt. The run continues in the background: returns {run_id, rows} at once; where the app is open, show_in_app (where offered; review_run + run_id) brings the table in front of the user; stop it with cancel_grid_run. To only put a collection's passages on the Tables page without asking anything, use show_in_app (where offered) with target table_rows. Every row is one model task for you; with many rows it uses a lot of the user's Claude quota - say how many before you start.

document_ids.description: With source_context_id: only chunks of these documents (list_documents). Omit it to use every document of the context.

follow_refs.description: Also follow outgoing norm references (default true).

grid_profile_id.description: Template (list_grid_profiles): prompt + answer columns. Default: the first template, as on the Tables page.

max_rows.description: With source_context_id: at most this many chunks (1-200, default 50).

prompt.description: The question/instruction applied to every row. Omit it to use the template's prompt.

reasoning.description: Reasoning depth for models that support it (default off).

retrieval_context_ids.description: Contexts to retrieve supporting passages from for each row, as evidence for the answer (default: none, the row is answered from its own text).

retrieval_prompt.description: Text put before the row text to form the retrieval query (default: the row text).

row_texts.description: Rows = these texts (1-200), one row each, e.g. passages you picked from a search; every row sees its own text only (plus retrieval_context_ids, if given). To fill the rows from a whole collection use source_context_id. Exclusive with source_context_id.

source_context_id.description: Rows = the passages of this context, one row per passage. Exclusive with row_texts.

tool_call_budget.description: Let the LLM search for itself with tools in every row: 0 = until the row's context window is nearly full (as the app does by default), any larger whole number = at most that many searches per row. Omit for one search per row before the model answers. Needs a tool-capable endpoint and retrieval_context_ids.

name: run_grid
